# Ezekiel 40 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 40:1 (overlap: 12%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | In-the-twenty-fifth year of-our-exile, at-the-beginning-of the-year, on-the-tenth of-the-month, in-the-fourteenth year after the-city was-struck, on-that-very day the-hand-of YHWH was upon-me, and-He-brought-me there. |
| LOGOS | In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was struck down, on that very day, the hand of the LORD was upon me, and He brought me to the city. |
| PNEUMA | On April 28, during the twenty-fifth year of our exile — fourteen years after the fall of Jerusalem — the LORD took hold of me and brought me there in a vision. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 40:2 (overlap: 14%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | In-visions-of God He-brought-me to the-land-of Israel and-set-me-down upon a-very-high mountain, and-upon-it [was] something-like a-structure-of a-city from-the-south. |
| LOGOS | In visions of God He brought me to the land of Israel, and set me down on a very high mountain, on which was a structure like a city to the south. |
| PNEUMA | In a vision from God, He brought me to the land of Israel and set me on a very high mountain. From there I could see what looked like a city to the south. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
